# 🛠️ Maintenance Checklist

## Routine
- [ ] Review Dependabot and dependency advisories.
- [ ] Review CodeQL and secret-scanning results.
- [ ] Review npm audit artifact and record high/critical risks.
- [ ] Run Jest and production build.
- [ ] Validate docs, project tree and SVG assets.
- [ ] Review gameplay/accessibility issues.
- [ ] Check README links and feature status.

## Dependency update
- [ ] Confirm purpose, direct/transitive status and license.
- [ ] Review advisories and release notes.
- [ ] Update package.json and lockfile together.
- [ ] Run clean install, tests and build.
- [ ] Record breaking changes and rollback.

## Architecture change
- [ ] Update diagrams and project structure.
- [ ] Update requirements, scope and threat model.
- [ ] Update privacy/data docs if storage/network behavior changes.
- [ ] Add ADR for material decisions.

Record owner, date, commit, findings and next review.
